'''Sohli bark''' was found on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], an [[Yoda's species/Legends|alien]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], gathered sohli bark from the area around his [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|home]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sohli bark was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'' written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] and released by [[Dorling Kindersley|DK Publishing ]] in [[1998]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
